Subject: Clarify observability add-on pricing for pilot/poC

Marcus / Jordan —

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the dashboard and tracing previews look promising. Procurement asked me to get a clearer breakdown for the three add-ons we discussed so we can size the POC budget:

- Retention: pricing per GB-month + archival delta
- Tracing: ingested spans per month and sampling tiers (what counts as a span)
- Advanced dashboards: seat vs aggregate metric billing (we'll likely have 12 power users + 150 viewers)

Two asks from my side: can Redwood provide a short cost-split for the 90-day pilot with projected usage (we estimate ~4 TB raw per month ingest, peak queries 600 QPS across dashboards) and a one-time pilot credit or discount for new customers? Procurement wants the numbers by next Tue (24-Feb) to get internal approval.

Attaching our internal usage mock (attachment: acme-usage-estimates.csv) — happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Clarify observability add-on pricing for pilot/poC

Emily — thanks for the notes and the numbers, that mock is helpful. High-level answers below; I'll follow with a short 1-page cost split PDF and a draft SOW.

Retention (90-day pilot projection)
- Billing unit: GB-month stored. For hot/active retention we charge $0.045/GB-month; cold archival tier (optional) at $0.010/GB-month.
- With your ingest (~4 TB/month) and expected retention window (30 days hot + move-to-cold afterward), estimate ~120 TB-month hot across pilot = ~$5,400 over 90 days. Archival for older snapshots would be incremental.

Tracing
- Billing: spans ingested where each span is a single traced operation event. We include free sampling up to 50M spans/month at the pilot tier. Over that, $0.002 per 1k spans.
- With your projected telemetry, anticipate ~180M spans/month (post-sampling) — pilot incremental cost ~((180-50)M / 1k)*$0.002 ≈ $260 per month.

Advanced dashboards
- Two-part model: "editor/seat" fee + query-execution metering. Editor seats: $35/user/month; viewers free for up to 200 active viewers. Query metering: $0.004 per dashboard query execution (heavy dashboards may bundle).
- For 12 editors over 3 months = 12*35*3 = $1,260. Query costs estimated ~600 QPS peak (bursty) — projected monthly query executions for pilot ~1.2M => ~$4,800/month.

Pilot cost summary (rough, pre-discount)
- Retention (hot): ~$5,400
- Tracing incremental: ~$780 (3 months)
- Dashboards seats: $1,260
- Dashboards query metering: ~$14,400 (3 months)
- Subtotal (90 days): ~$21,840

Notes and options:
- We can limit query metering by enabling a query cache/aggregation layer for the pilot (reduces query metering by ~40% typical) — would cut dashboard query costs considerably.
- We typically offer a pilot credit structure (see Jordan's note). I'll attach the one-pager and SOW now.

Attachments: ACME_Retention_Pricing_v2.pdf (high-level cost split), RetentionTrace_SOW_draft_acme.docx (SOW stub)

Would you like the numbers broken down in a single-line PoC quote (for procurement)? If yes I'll mark it as "pilot quote" and Jordan will propose credits.

— Marcus
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Emily — following Marcus with the commercial levers we can offer. Short version: we can construct a pilot concession that reduces your 90-day invoice and gives credit toward committed Reserved capacity if you convert to a 12-month Dedicated commitment.

Proposed pilot concession (one-time):
- 40% credit applied to dashboard query metering for the first 90 days (to offset exploratory queries)
- Waive first-month editor seat fees for up to 15 editors
- $10K one-time pilot credit that can be applied to retention or tracing line items (your choice)

If Acme converts to a 12-month Reserved Dedicated contract (commitment to throughput tier), we can tier that into a 15% commitment discount on add-ons and roll the $10K pilot credit into the first invoice. Conditions: mutual NPS check-ins and case study permission (standard).

Samplings on query caching: we can also pre-configure caching for your heavy dashboard panels; in our experience that reduces metered query executions by 30–50% depending on panel composition. Marcus can scope config work for the POC (approx 2-3 engineer days).

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
